body.objective: Construct the zero-mode-completed weighted BT squeeze on an explicit Krein carrier, determine the largest canonical cyclic Born-trace domain it supports, and classify whether that trace survives the thermodynamic limit.
activates: cross-Krein realization of the Appendix-C squeeze
body.current_gate: CROSS_KREIN_TRACE_LIMIT: complete the Laurent orbit to a genuine Krein space, build the weighted squeeze on a common core, construct the finite-rank cyclic trace, and test normalized trace extension and trace-norm convergence as volume tends to infinity.
body.stop_condition: Certify an explicit cross-Krein squeeze implementation and cyclic trace through the thermodynamic limit, or prove the first exact trace-extension or normal-limit obstruction while retaining the strongest finite-regulator construction.
body.forbid: no finite-rank trace promoted to a trace on the full operator algebra; no finite-volume identity promoted to a thermodynamic limit; no positive normalization allowed to silently change Krein idempotence; no squeeze-factor construction called the full nonlinear R_t; no scalar-to-gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL transfer
body.resource_hint: Use the exact orbit completion ell^2(Z) with J e_n=e_-n and the rho_mu weighted oscillator Fock space. Separate algebraic finite-rank cyclicity, finite normalized trace extension, and positive trace-norm convergence. Run sequentially under ulimit -v 500000.
